// Included only by the disposable hosted service-upgrade overlay.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"MODULE_PATH/internal/daemon"
)

func init() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 || os.Args[1] != "hosted-upgrade-fixture" {
		return
	}
	if err := daemon.RunHostedUpgradeFixture(os.Args[2]); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "disposable HQ upgrade fixture unavailable")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	os.Exit(0)
}
